package.name: stl2curves
package.description: Turn meshes (STL, 3MF) into solids with true curved surfaces: holes, fillets, chamfers, screw threads and smooth areas become real cylinders, cones, tori, helices and B-spline faces you can select, measure and edit. Adds "Mesh to Curved Solid" to the Part and Mesh workbenches. Downloads OpenCascade (cadquery-ocp), numpy and scipy for its own use on first run.
package.author: Daniel Copeland

workbench.name: stl2curves
workbench.description: Mesh to Curved Solid command, added to the Part and Mesh workbenches
